items.title: Small plane crashes into Beijing's tallest building
items.description: Two bystanders have said an aircraft about the size of a car has crashed into Beijing's CITIC Tower.

items.title: Ukraine launches one of its heaviest drone attacks on Russia
items.description: Authorities in Russian-annexed Crimea have declared an "emergency situation".

items.title: Andrew 'Twiggy' Forrest warns Fortescue staff after sexual harassment class action
items.description: In an email sent to all staff, Mr Forrest said: "Anyone who thinks this behaviour has a place at Fortescue is in the wrong company."

items.title: Broncos coach rejects claim season is done despite seventh straight loss
items.description: Queensland halfback Sam Walker is put on report for a shoulder charge in the Roosters' 24-18 win over Brisbane, potentially ruling him out of State of Origin III.

items.title: 'Feels like we've been scammed': Graduates unhappy with uni degrees
items.description: Australian students are the least satisfied they have ever been with their university degrees, according to a long-running survey, leaving some questioning the value of their qualifications.

items.title: Hundreds killed as Venezuela struck by 'doublet' earthquake
items.description: The deadly one-two punch that toppled buildings in Venezuela's capital and beyond was a doublet earthquake, a pair of similar-sized quakes close in location and time.

items.title: How China's new 'ethnic unity' law could target people in Australia
items.description: The Australian government raises concerns directly with China over the country's new ethnic unity law, which allows Beijing to target people overseas.

items.title: Stefanovic's move to outsider politics follows a well-worn lucrative path
items.description: Listening to the culture war showman schtick he has so quickly adopted, Karl Stefanovic is now less a newsman than an ideological performer.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers

items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
